question: What was each method validated FOR? A single ROC-AUC answers one of five questions, and ADR-AIIM-164 showed that one was asked against an uninformative baseline.

axes.pose_accuracy: Docking power: RMSD to a crystallographic pose
axes.interaction_recovery: Does the pose reproduce the Asn253 anchor?

references.CASF-2016: Su, Yang, Li, Liu, Han, Wang. Comparative Assessment of Scoring Functions: The CASF-2016 Update. J Chem Inf Model 2019;59(2):895-913. Decouples scoring / ranking / docking / screening power; reports docking power as the strongest of the four for current functions.
references.PoseBusters: Buttenschoen, Morris, Deane. PoseBusters: AI-based docking methods fail to generate physically valid poses or generalise to novel sequences. Chem Sci 2024;15:3130-3139.
references.DL-limits: Li, et al. Decoding the limits of deep learning in molecular docking for drug discovery. Chem Sci 2025. Five dimensions: pose accuracy, physical plausibility, interaction recovery, virtual-screening efficacy, generalisation.
references.MMGBSA-rescoring: Sahakyan. Improving virtual screening results with MM/GBSA and MM/PBSA rescoring. J Comput Aided Mol Des 2021;35:731-736; and Zhang et al., J Chem Inf Model 2014;54:324-337, which reports MM/GBSA rescoring raising AUC over Vina across 38 DUD-E targets while remaining target-dependent and limited by pose quality.

computes_nothing: Every value is read from a frozen artifact named beside it. This file is an index, not a result.

pose_accuracy.caveat: all three structures were solved with ZM241385: the receptor changed, the ligand never did

ligand_transfer.value: 0.216 A redocking 9XT, a chemically distinct antagonist, into its own crystal (5OLH); 9.606 A into 4EIY

interaction_recovery.value: 2.71 A on the redocked control (contact); 0 of 7 other known antagonists placed in the contact

screening_power.value: AUC 0.601 (95 % CI 0.510-0.683), against 0.584 for heavy-atom count alone, paired p = 0.722

scoring_power.value: r = -0.481 (p = 0.228) against measured pChEMBL over 8 antagonists; -0.657 (p = 0.039) over all 10 reference ligands, carried by two agonists

rows.licence: Geometry, for ZM241385-like chemotypes. Not ranking, not affinity.

pose_accuracy.value: 1.917 A on the ZM241385 control, passing a 2.0 A gate by 0.083 A

physical_validity.value: 2 of 4 rank-1 poses valid; the control is among the failures
physical_validity.note: the pose that passed the RMSD gate overlaps the receptor. RMSD and validity disagree on the same pose, which is the PoseBusters result reproduced on a GPCR target.

screening_power.value: not measured: DiffDock was run on four compounds as an orthogonal pose check, never over the benchmark

rows.licence: Nothing. Its one validated pose is physically invalid, so the RMSD it passed on does not certify it.

pose_accuracy.value: n/a -- rescores poses, does not make them

screening_power.note: published expectation is the opposite: MM/GBSA rescoring usually raises AUC over docking alone, though it is target-dependent and bounded by the quality of the poses it rescores. The pose-validity and interaction-recovery cells in the Vina row are where that bound bites here.
screening_power.source: exp3b_harmonized_metrics.csv; provenance caveat in ADR-AIIM-048 (equilibration and seed records incomplete)

rows.licence: Nothing, on this target, at this pose quality. Reported as a measurement rather than omitted.

interaction_recovery.value: the Asn253 filter carried weak signal in isolation (27 % of compounds forming the contact were active against 19 % of those that did not)

screening_power.value: AUC 0.449 (95 % CI 0.343-0.545), below chance, with BEDROC20 0.495 against the baseline's 0.275

rows.licence: Early recognition only, and not claimed: at n = 245 the 1 % cut is 2.45 compounds.

screening_power.value: paired dAUC +0.0028 (95 % CI -0.0568 to +0.0588) against a threshold of +0.05 fixed before the pilot

rows.licence: Stopped by a pre-registered rule, not by a verdict on the method.

screening_power.value: nested cross-validated AUC 0.909 +/- 0.020, with Y-randomisation over 100 label permutations

rows.licence: Ranking, inside its applicability domain -- which excludes this library in four of eight spaces.
